newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon says faces lawsuit in the U.S..
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon says faces lawsuit in the U.S..

text.p: Germany's SGL Carbon AG said on Tuesday its U.S. unit had been presented with a class action lawsuit over price fixing there.
The company said in a mandatory statement that the allegations where without merit and that it had not been charged by any official authorities.
SGL said its U.S. unit, SGL Carbon Corp, among other companies, was being accused by a group of steel makers of collaborating on prices of graphite electrodes.
The German company denied it had done anything wrong and said it would fight the accustations with all legal means.

Earlier this month, SGL said it was being probed by U.S. and European Union official on price-fixing allegations and said it was cooperating with authorities in both countries who searched the company's records.
The other companies facing the class acution suit are UCAR International Inc and Carbide/Graphite Group Inc, SGL said.
